fetchUser = (id) -> Promise.resolve({ id: id ?? 0 })
missing = null
obj = { v: 7, load: -> Promise.resolve(@v) }
bare = fetchUser?!
none = missing?!
args = fetchUser?! 1
paren = fetchUser?!(2)
method = obj.load?!
chain = fetchUser?!(3).id
fallback = missing?! ?? "absent"
list = [missing?!, fetchUser?!(4)]
text = "#{missing?!}"
spread = {...fetchUser?!(6), extra: 1}
nothing = {...missing?!, kept: true}
run = (cb) -> cb?! 5
ran = run (n) -> Promise.resolve(n * 2)
out = [bare, none, args, paren, method, chain, fallback, list, text, spread, nothing, ran]
